items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Jan Garber he was going to be the second Bing Crosby

ctx.x: The lead sheets. You had the lead sheets and had a violin score, you see, and I would get these things and learn these things. I wasn't smoking and drinking then, you see, and you got the megaphone to the mike which later on when I was going to go to the (Nebraska) Lincoln University to be with Lee Bennett at KFAB that went to Jan Garber he was going to be the second Bing Crosby and Russ Colombo, you know what I mean. But here I come, singing "All of Me" and I had all these things. And incidentally, it was a very…
